selection.ownership: Kaleido Inc., a Delaware corporation with global headquarters at 16 W. Martin Street, Raleigh, North Carolina, United States. The reviewed edition is the public platform API at console.kaleido.io, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Kaleido Platform API (Bearer, GET /memberships, /consortia, /consortia/{id}/environments), default US host console.kaleido.io, regional console-eu/ap/ko/us1 hosts, Kaleido Inc. Raleigh/Delaware identity, privacy policy 2025-10-15, and dated incident search (Kaleido + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Consensys 2026 contractor-access reporting is a related-ecosystem parent, not Kaleido Inc. platform compromise. No qualifying Kaleido platform incident found in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

apikeys.create.description: Create a new organization API key via POST /apikeys. The returned secret is one-time viewable. Maps to KALEIDO_CREATE_API_KEY.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the API key.

apikeys.create.title: Create API key

apikeys.delete.description: Permanently delete an API key via DELETE /apikeys/{apikey_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_DELETE_API_KEY.
apikeys.delete.title: Delete API key

apikeys.get.description: Retrieve a specific API key by ID via GET /apikeys/{apikey_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_API_KEY.
apikeys.get.title: Get API key

apikeys.list.description: List organization API keys via GET /apikeys. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_API_KEYS.
apikeys.list.title: List API keys

appcreds.list.description: List application credentials for an environment via GET /consortia/{consortia_id}/environments/{environment_id}/appcreds. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.
appcreds.list.title: List application credentials

billing.summary.get.description: Retrieve the current-month billing summary for an organization via GET /orgs/{org_id}/billing/summary. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_BILLING_SUMMARY.

month.description: Month name (january, february, …). Defaults to the current month.

year.description: Billing year (for example 2025). Defaults to the current year.

billing.summary.get.title: Get billing summary

consortia.get.description: Get details for a specific Kaleido consortium.
consortia.get.title: Get consortium

consortia.list.description: List Kaleido consortia available to the current membership. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_CONSORTIA.

limit.description: Maximum number of consortia to return per request.

skip.description: Number of consortia records to skip (offset-based pagination).

consortia.list.title: List consortia

environments.list.description: List environments in a specific Kaleido consortium.
environments.list.title: List environments

event_streams.list.description: List Ethconnect event streams via GET /eventstreams on the Kaleido console API (Composio console fallback). Maps to KALEIDO_GET_EVENT_STREAMS.

full_url.description: Optional Ethconnect override URL. Caller-supplied hosts are not admitted.

node_id.description: Optional Kaleido node ID exposing Ethconnect. Not interpolated into the host.

service_api_base_url.description: Optional Token Factory / HD Wallet / Ethconnect service API base URL. Caller-supplied hosts are not interpolated (SSRF). Requests stay on console.kaleido.io, matching Composio's console fallback.

zone_domain.description: Optional zone domain such as us-east-1.connect.kaleido.io. Not interpolated into the host.

event_streams.list.title: List event streams

healthcheck.description: Validate the Kaleido API key with GET /memberships.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

identity_proofs.create.description: Add an x509 identity proof to an organization via POST /orgs/{org_id}/idproofs. Maps to KALEIDO_ADD_IDENTITY_PROOF.

name.description: Human-readable name for the identity proof.

payload.description: Base64-encoded x509 certificate chain (PEM converted to Base64).

type.description: Identity proof type. Currently only x509 is supported.

identity_proofs.create.title: Add identity proof

identity_proofs.delete.description: Remove an identity proof via DELETE /orgs/{org_id}/idproofs/{proof_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_DELETE_ORGANIZATION_IDENTITY_PROOF.
identity_proofs.delete.title: Delete identity proof

identity_proofs.get.description: Retrieve a specific identity proof via GET /orgs/{org_id}/idproofs/{proof_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_IDENTITY_PROOF.
identity_proofs.get.title: Get identity proof

invitations.list.description: List invitations targeting the current user via GET /invitations. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_INVITATIONS.
invitations.list.title: List invitations

memberships.list.description: List Kaleido memberships available to the current API key. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_MEMBERSHIPS.

query.description: Optional Mongo-style query string to filter memberships.

memberships.list.title: List memberships

orgs.billing_provider.get.description: Retrieve billing provider details (aws, stripe, or other) via GET /orgs/{org_id}/billing/provider. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_ORG_BILLING_PROVIDER.
orgs.billing_provider.get.title: Get organization billing provider

orgs.get.description: Retrieve a Kaleido organization via GET /orgs/{org_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_ORGANIZATION.
orgs.get.title: Get organization

orgs.list.description: List organizations the API key can access via GET /orgs. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_ORGANIZATIONS.
orgs.list.title: List organizations

orgs.plan.get.description: Retrieve subscription plan details and limits via GET /orgs/{org_id}/plan. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_ORGANIZATION_PLAN.
orgs.plan.get.title: Get organization plan

orgs.update.description: Update organization properties via PATCH /orgs/{org_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_UPDATE_ORGANIZATION.

billing_account.description: Billing account details for updating an organization.

type.description: Billing provider type (none, aws, or stripe).

cognito_client_id.description: Cognito app client ID for Enterprise logins.

cognito_client_secret.description: Cognito app client secret for Enterprise logins.

cognito_user_pool_id.description: Cognito user pool ID for Enterprise logins.

delegate.description: Email exposed on consortia memberships as contact info.

terms_accepted.description: Unix milliseconds timestamp of last terms acceptance.

trial_ends.description: ISO8601 date when the organization's trial is expected to end.

orgs.update.title: Update organization

plans.list.description: List available Kaleido subscription plans via GET /plans. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_PLANS.
plans.list.title: List plans

regions.list.description: List Kaleido deployment regions and console hosts via GET /regions. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_REGIONS.
regions.list.title: List regions

releases.list.description: List blockchain node software releases via GET /releases. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_RELEASES.
releases.list.title: List releases

roles.get.description: Retrieve a user role assignment via GET /orgs/{org_id}/roles/{role_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_ROLE_BY_ID.
roles.get.title: Get role

roles.list.description: List user role assignments for an organization via GET /orgs/{org_id}/roles. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_ROLES.
roles.list.title: List roles

roles.update.description: Update a user's organization role via PATCH /orgs/{org_id}/roles/{role_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_UPDATE_ORG_ROLE.

role.description: Role to assign. Currently only admin is supported.

roles.update.title: Update organization role

roles.upsert.description: Create or update a user role assignment via PUT /orgs/{org_id}/roles/{role_id}. Maps to KALEIDO_UPSERT_ORGANIZATION_ROLE.

role.description: Role to assign. Currently only admin is supported.

user_id.description: User ID to assign the role to (required when creating).

roles.upsert.title: Upsert organization role

services.list.description: List services the current user owns or can see via GET /services. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_SERVICES.
services.list.title: List services

token_factory.tokens.list.description: List Token Factory contracts via GET /contracts on the Kaleido console API (Composio console fallback). Maps to KALEIDO_GET_TOKEN_FACTORY_TOKENS.

service_api_base_url.description: Optional Token Factory / HD Wallet / Ethconnect service API base URL. Caller-supplied hosts are not interpolated (SSRF). Requests stay on console.kaleido.io, matching Composio's console fallback.

token_factory.tokens.list.title: List token factory tokens

wallets.accounts.get.description: Retrieve an HD wallet account at a derivation index via GET /wallets/{wallet_id}/accounts/{account_index}. Maps to KALEIDO_GET_WALLET_ACCOUNT_NONCE.

account_index.description: Derivation index of the account within the HD wallet (0 to 2147483648).

service_api_base_url.description: Optional Token Factory / HD Wallet / Ethconnect service API base URL. Caller-supplied hosts are not interpolated (SSRF). Requests stay on console.kaleido.io, matching Composio's console fallback.

wallets.accounts.get.title: Get wallet account

wallets.list.description: List HD wallet IDs via GET /wallets on the Kaleido console API (Composio console fallback). Maps to KALEIDO_GET_WALLETS.

service_api_base_url.description: Optional Token Factory / HD Wallet / Ethconnect service API base URL. Caller-supplied hosts are not interpolated (SSRF). Requests stay on console.kaleido.io, matching Composio's console fallback.

wallets.list.title: List wallets
